build_visual_entailment_dataset: build a VisualEntailmentDataset instance from config and imdb file index for visual entailment tasks
load_item_by_index: load a sample item by index from the VisualEntailmentDataset with text and image features
map_label_to_int: map visual entailment labels like entailment, neutral, or contradiction to integer values using LABEL_TO_INT_MAPPING
format_for_prediction: format prediction results from the VisualEntailmentDataset by calling format_for_prediction on the dataset
review_load_item_method: review the load_item method of VisualEntailmentDataset to understand how samples are processed and returned
